scene_prompt: Wide establishing shot of a woman with a lean, toned physique holding a standing split on a yoga mat at a sunlit beach, one leg planted firmly, the other extended straight up overhead past vertical, both hands gripping her raised ankle, body folded forward against her standing leg, wearing a white string bikini top and white high-waist bikini bottoms, bare feet on the mat. Soft white sand stretching behind her, pale blue ocean horizon beyond, bright morning light from the left catching every line of the pose. Shot on a Contax T2, Kodak Ektar 100, 38mm f/4, soft background, rich analog texture. Keep her face, hair, and body exactly the same.
video_prompt: Wide establishing shot. 0-2s: She holds the standing split completely still, raised leg vertical and beyond, grip firm on her ankle — a light ocean breeze moves slowly through her hair, waves rolling softly in the distance. 2-5s: She releases her ankle deliberately and unfolds upright, raised leg sweeping down and behind her slowly into a deep standing backbend, arms arching overhead toward the mat. 5-8s: She flows forward from the backbend into a full front split on the mat, sinking all the way down, chest lowering slowly toward the ground, arms extending wide — held at the deepest point. 8-10s: She breathes visibly, completely still in the split, the morning light raking across her body. Camera stays completely still.
caption: flexibility is a lifestyle 🤍 #yoga #flex #beachyoga
